text:
mike: Heads-up after deploying rbac-simplify-1.2 — editors in Dedicated pools can't hit Create model. Button is disabled in console even though API shows they have model:create. Repro below. :confused:

nina: Which deploy tag exactly? @anil can you take a look?

mike: deploy tag rbac-simplify-1.2 (deploy-bot announced it). Example: user u_1122 on org-90, project p_dedicated_7 (dedicated pool). Console UX: Create model button grayed out.

anil: Can you paste the two permission endpoints? UI should check project-scoped perms, then fall back to org-scoped.

mike: Project endpoint returns empty perms: `GET /api/v1/projects/p_dedicated_7/permissions?user=u_1122` -> `{ "user":"u_1122", "role": null, "permissions": [] }`. Org endpoint returns expected editor perms: `GET /api/v1/orgs/org-90/permissions?user=u_1122` -> `{ "user":"u_1122", "role":"editor", "permissions": ["model:list","model:create","project:edit"] }`.

nina: So backend has org perms, UI chose project perms and didn't fallback. That implies the new mapper set an explicit project-level empty assignment instead of relying on inherit flag. Did the refactor change the `inherit_org` semantics?

anil: Looking at DB: `select inherit_org, resource_type, role_alias from rbac_roles where resource_id='p_dedicated_7';` returns `inherit_org:false` for several project rows. The migration `20260401_add_inherit_flag` apparently didn't backfill correctly on all hosts. Replica lag + migration locking issue caused inconsistent flip.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: "deployment rbac-simplify-1.2 started at 2026-04-01T13:10Z"

sec-oncall: Impact assessment: availability bug (editors blocked from create). Not exposing extra perms so low security severity but high product impact for Dedicated customers. Flagging P2. Need audit entries for the migration and any role-change events.

mike: Quick frontend mitigation: I'll make UI check org endpoint if project returns empty, behind feature flag `rbac-fallback-checked`. Will push a tiny patch to toggle quickly.

ux: Good idea — render an affordance with tooltip "insufficient project-level permissions, checking org-level" rather than silent disable so users aren't confused.

anil: Forensics: migration job log shows `ERROR: could not obtain lock on table rbac_roles` on host db-replica-2, so it skipped backfill there. That left rows with inherit_org=false even though intention was true. Query to find affected: `SELECT org_id FROM rbac_roles WHERE inherit_org=false AND resource_type='project' AND is_dedicated=true;` -> returns org-90 and org-112.

mike: Repro commands I used locally:

```
# repro
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/projects/p_dedicated_7/permissions?user=u_1122" | jq
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/orgs/org-90/permissions?user=u_1122" | jq
```

ops-bot: migration-runner queued: migration=20260401_add_inherit_flag run_id=mig-20260401-21 (eta ~90s)

anil: Plan: re-run migration with `SKIP_LOCK=false` and backfill only for rows where `role_alias IN ('editor','viewer')` and `is_dedicated=true`. Will run in controlled window and stream logs. Also add post-check: `SELECT count(*) FROM rbac_roles WHERE inherit_org=false AND is_dedicated=true;` should be 0.

sec-oncall: Also add alert: if migration leaves >0 inconsistent rows for >5m, page eng-sre and sec-oncall. Capture audit events for the backfill and store run_id in incident ticket.

mike: Frontend PR pushed -> will flip `rbac-fallback-checked=true` for the affected orgs while backfill runs. This ensures the UI checks org perms when project perms empty. Telemetry: added `rbac.ui.fallback_checked` counter.

anil: Migration run mig-20260401-21 started at 2026-04-01T13:15Z; backfill executed; pre-check count=27 -> post-check count=0. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/mig-20260401-21

ops-bot: migration-runner: mig-20260401-21 completed successfully at 2026-04-01T13:21Z

mike: Verified with u_1122 — Create button enabled again. Project and org permission endpoints consistent.

nina: Closing immediate customer-facing issue. Follow-ups: add migration preflight to check replica locks, add DB advisory-lock retry wrapper in migration tooling, add integration test simulating dedicated resources perms and UI fallback.

sec-oncall: Assigned follow-up owners in INC-20260401-7. Root cause: migration lock failure on replica left inherit_org unset -> UI strictly honored project-level absence and didn't fallback.

mike: Thanks all. I'll update the ticket with run ids and the screenshot we used for repro. :+1:
